messages.author: 60658bf54ba682ab
messages.subject: data format
parts:
Hey all,

I am trying to use unmarked to calculate bird densities from line transect data collected before and during a cull in four regions (BACI). My aim it to asses if the target species densities decreased, and if any corresponding changes in native species were seen. Surveys were conducted at 8 transects (treatment area) and 4 transects (control area) twice a month for 5 months before an invasive species cull (10 repeats). During the cull, surveys were conducted once a month at the same transects for 12 months (12 repeats). All birds seen or heard within the 50m (each way) strip width on a 1000m transect were recorded (100,000m2).

I am having trouble understanding how to format the data frame to analyze the data using gdistsamp. I have already successfully ran the data using distsamp, but models had poor fit (very few records at 0m on the transect). I am after an example data frame showing how you would set up the formatting of a data frame for a multi-survey, multi species approach. Currently i am running into errors using gdistamp and i know it is related to the data frame being set up incorrectly.

If someone has their own code and a few rows of data they would be willing to share that would be amazing.

messages.author: 4a15de51da4445ae
messages.subject: Re: data format
parts:
hi Grant,
 you should check out the help file for gdistsamp  -- the example there simulates data and you can see precisely the correct format for that. gdistsamp is the function to use when you have repeated DS surveys.
 We do not have any capability in unmarked to deal with multi-species DS models.
regards
andy
